title: Scoped Freeze / Release Clock Grammar
principle: A scoped FREEZE_UNTIL_RELEASE pauses only the named local clock; nonparticipants retain phase and unchanged support/root is not re-keyed.

timing_policy.name: STREET_FIGHTER/CAPCOM
timing_policy.note: Nonuniform gameplay timing vocabulary may mix holds, fast transitions, impact/hit-stop, recoil/recovery holds, silhouette exaggeration, and selective sampling. Every timing assignment in this specimen is INFERRED, not source-authentic.

source.name: Robot
source.whole_sheet_evidence_origin: Current run re-read of campaign evidence from the prior full-sheet custody/inspection; historical timing pass is evidence only and is not the V2 product.
observed: The source is one complete static 445x554 PNG sheet.
The whole sheet contains multiple action/state families, including long repeated-state strips and short transition/consequence families.
A second B-skin family repeats comparable idle/walk/hurt organization.
Large portions of body organization recur while local presentation changes.
unknown: source playback order within every row
source.rights_note: Copyrighted source sprites are evidence only. No source pixels, palette, contours, layout, tracing, redistribution, or close imitation enter this specimen. Only abstract timing/channel principles are retained.

axis_partition.temporal_axis: Only authored abstract clock-state changes and causal sync events become decisive keys.
axis_partition.variant_configuration_axis: The observed B-skin/repeated presentation families are collapsed as configuration/equivalence evidence and consume no time keys.
axis_partition.effect_axis: Local/effect-like presentation is treated as an independent channel unless causality explicitly joins it.
axis_partition.rule: Separate axes before cadence. Sheet adjacency or visual multiplicity is not chronology.

clock_channels.note: Static support/root for entire specimen; never duplicated merely because local clocks change.
Freezes at its authored phase until release.

keys.name: FREE_RUN_ZERO
keys.motion_arc_root_note: BASE root/support held; local A/B phases differ; no causal join.

keys.name: A_PHASE_ADVANCE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Left local arc descends; right local phase and root/support remain unchanged.
keys.causal_role: advance A without spending a B or BASE key

keys.name: B_PHASE_ADVANCE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Right local arc rises; A and BASE retain authored state.
keys.causal_role: advance B as a transient local information spike

keys.name: FREEZE_B
keys.motion_arc_root_note: External event freezes SIGNAL_B at UP; SIGNAL_A may advance; BASE stays planted.

keys.name: A_CONTINUES_B_HELD
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Left local arc advances while right local arc is explicitly held; root/support unchanged.
keys.causal_role: prove nonparticipant phase continuity during freeze

keys.name: RELEASE_B
keys.motion_arc_root_note: SIGNAL_B is released without hidden in-between or BASE reset; it resumes from held phase.

keys.name: B_RESUMES
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Right local arc advances only after release; BASE remains the same support key throughout.

compile.method: AUTHORED ASCII KEYS -> EXPLICIT HOLDS/TIMING -> DETERMINISTIC CONNECTIVE MOTION -> ASCII-ONLY FRAME RENDER -> MP4 -> SELF-CONTAINED SPA
compile.connector_rule: One midpoint connector is permitted only when gate_state is unchanged and no endpoint is a causal event; interpolate only local tip coordinates. Event boundaries hard-cut. Connectors cannot change support/root/clock authority.
compile.renderer: Python/Pillow renders literal generated ASCII frames; ffmpeg libx264 yuv420p.
